mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), reduced manufacturing output and potential recessionary pressures cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration that precedes stock market corrections, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market weakness (HOUST < 1250 thousand units), reduced consumer confidence and spending lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 1250, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
